messages.subject: [Phylobase-devl] Build fails for MacOS X
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

  I recently realized that I didn't release phylobase 0.6.3 on CRAN.
While checking on R-forge the status on the builds before doing so, it
looks that it doesn't build on MacOS X. Is it a glitch from R-forge or
is there really a problem?

  Thanks,
  -- Fran?ois

messages.body_plain:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA1

On 03/21/2011 10:00 AM, Fran?ois Michonneau wrote:
> 
> Hi all,
> 
>   I recently realized that I didn't release phylobase 0.6.3 on CRAN.
> While checking on R-forge the status on the builds before doing so, it
> looks that it doesn't build on MacOS X. Is it a glitch from R-forge or
> is there really a problem?
> 
>   Thanks,
>   -- Fran?ois

  It passes R CMD check just fine on R 2.12.1 under MacOS X here.  The
error message looks pretty obscure (compiler bus error [!]). It sounds
worth asking the r-forge maintainers?

  Other building news:

  checking CRAN build tests:

  failing on Solaris (do we care???)
<http://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-prerel-solaris-sparc/phylobase-00check.html>
<http://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-prerel-solaris-x86/phylobase-00check.html>

Failing on windows, but this looks like a glitch in the build system (it
can't load the ape package because it can't find the nlme package ??)
<http://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-release-windows-ix86+x86_64/phylobase-00check.html>

  We're getting a few "notes" on the other builds on CRAN, e.g.

<http://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-devel-linux-ix86/phylobase-00check.html>

checking installed package size ... NOTE
installed size is 11.6Mb
sub-directories of 1Mb or more:
libs 10.4Mb

  [don't know if we can do anything about this, it's probably just from
building all of NCL?]

  There is another NOTE regarding partial matching which I hope to have
fixed on r-forge.

  The RUnit test output is *very* noisy at the moment.

  cheers
    Ben

messages.body_plain:
Thanks for checking on this Ben.

  I think the Solaris issue is caused by Rcpp. Maybe if we specify to
use the latest version of Rcpp in the DESCRIPTION file it'll work.
Otherwise, we can send an email to Dirk.

  I can commit an updated output for the RUnit tests if needed.

  Cheers,
  -- Fran?ois
